easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Polluted Delta.
description:
Fetch a land using Polluted Delta.
When the fetched land enters, The Lost and the Damned and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Lost and the Damned trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Lost and the Damned trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Lost and the Damned triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
